source: User-supplied Master Logistics Exception Investigation Playbook

families.S: Master case catalogue: barcode scanners and shipment identity
families.C: Custody, misplaced shipments and potentially lost parcels
families.G: GPS, driver routes, vehicle movement and ETA cases
families.D: Offline scanners, devices, synchronization and software problems
families.P: Delivery failures, missing proof and incorrect delivery statuses
families.R: False reports, incorrect claims and customer disputes
families.Q: Package condition, weight and physical integrity
families.L: Returns, reverse logistics and failed deliveries
families.I: International shipping, documentation and regulatory holds

scope_note: Catalogue presence, source availability, investigatability, action support and verified lifecycle are distinct. No live model accuracy is claimed. This catalogue is not a shipment answer key.

cases.title: No scan recorded
cases.source_evidence: Last successful scan; expected scan point; scanner activity; next scan; container records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Could be a skipped scan, upload delay or genuinely missing parcel. Check device and subsequent custody evidence before requesting a rescan.

cases.title: Barcode unreadable
cases.source_evidence: Repeated read failures; barcode image or verification grade; other scanners' results
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Damaged/poorly printed label or scanner problem. Use a second scanner or verified identifier; relabel through an audited process if necessary.

cases.title: Barcode misread
cases.source_evidence: Raw scanned value; expected barcode; checksum; scan confidence; second read
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Optical misread is plausible when a new high-quality read matches the manifest. Request controlled rescan.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Compare optical error with wrong label/parcel and duplicate identity.
cases.verification_condition: Independent high-quality, package/facility-bound matching read; clear remaining exceptions.

cases.title: Wrong label on parcel
cases.source_evidence: Observed barcode; order ID; parcel identity; packing record; weight; physical description
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: The label may belong to another order. Quarantine identity, verify against original packing evidence, relabel only with authorization.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Repeated mismatch can mean wrong label or wrong physical parcel; neither is established by one read.
cases.verification_condition: Continued mismatch remains unresolved; identity disposition needs authorized review.

cases.title: Duplicate tracking barcode
cases.source_evidence: Same identifier attached to multiple physical observations; label-print audit
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Label duplication or identity collision. Hold conflicting units and establish distinct verified identities.

cases.title: Duplicate scan event
cases.source_evidence: Same event ID, timestamp, device, scan point and request-retry IDs
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Likely retransmission or repeated scanning. Deduplicate idempotently; don't infer two physical movements.

cases.title: Scan from wrong facility
cases.source_evidence: Scan point, device assignment, previous and following scans, manifest
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Could be missort, incorrect facility mapping or erroneous scan metadata. Check physical receiving.

cases.title: Impossible scan sequence
cases.source_evidence: Two scans far apart in an implausibly short time; clock offsets; raw ingestion timestamps
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible clock error, duplicated ID or identity mistake. Validate event clocks and identity first.

cases.title: Scanner systematically misreads
cases.source_evidence: Error rates across many parcels handled by the same scanner; control scans
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Shared device, calibration or label-reading issue. Test and service device; reassess affected shipments.

cases.title: Scan accepted but status unchanged
cases.source_evidence: Raw scan event, ingestion acknowledgement, status projection, processing logs
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Tracking-status pipeline problem. Recompute status from valid source events rather than inventing a scan.

cases.title: Package received but not shelved
cases.source_evidence: Receiving scan; put-away task; shelf scan; subsequent handling
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missed put-away record or misplaced package. Search receiving bay and intended storage zone.

cases.title: Package assigned to wrong shelf
cases.source_evidence: Last shelf scan; storage task; pick attempt; location history
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Incorrect put-away. Confirm physically and update location with a new auditable event.

cases.title: Parcel disappears during sorting
cases.source_evidence: Induction scan; sorter diverter logs; chute/bag IDs; reject lane
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Failed sort, rejected barcode or physical misplacement. Inspect last confirmed sorter segment and reject area.

cases.title: Package placed in wrong container
cases.source_evidence: Package-to-container events; container closure and destination; scan observations
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missort. Trace container and arrange intercept or rerouting.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Mis-sort versus incorrect container membership or stale manifest.
cases.verification_condition: New physical receiving/location evidence; operational reroute retains approval.

cases.title: Container delivered, one parcel unaccounted for
cases.symptom: Container delivered, one parcel unaccounted for
cases.source_evidence: Container membership, sealing/unsealing, item-level receiving scans
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missing individual scan or missing parcel. Inventory container and receiving area.

cases.title: Parcel marked received but absent from inventory
cases.symptom: Parcel marked received but absent from inventory
cases.source_evidence: Receiving device, bin records, later picks, inventory reconciliation
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Inventory projection error or physical misplacement. Reconcile source events and perform directed search.

cases.title: Parcel found in wrong warehouse
cases.source_evidence: Current physical scan; expected routing; linehaul history
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Confirmed routing deviation if identity and scan are reliable. Issue authorized correction.

cases.title: Warehouse backlog
cases.source_evidence: Queue sizes, item processing timestamps, staffing capacity, throughput
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Shared processing delay. Prioritize affected service levels and identify bottleneck.

cases.title: Parcels left after truck departure
cases.source_evidence: Loading confirmations; manifest; trailer departure; warehouse stock check
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Manifest assignment without physical loading. Verify stock and move to the next authorized trip.

cases.title: Parcel physically present, system says departed
cases.symptom: Parcel physically present, system says departed
cases.source_evidence: Warehouse stock scan; outbound event source; manifest versions
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: False departure status or unrecorded return. Reconcile the conflicting records; don't erase the history.

cases.title: Damaged parcel held in warehouse
cases.source_evidence: Damage report, photos, quality-control hold, subsequent events
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Physical exception requiring inspection, repackaging or claim workflow.

cases.title: Parcel scanned into two storage locations
cases.symptom: Parcel scanned into two storage locations
cases.source_evidence: Scan times; physical identifier; device clocks; bin inventory
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Duplicate identity, stale record or unauthorized location change. Establish latest verified physical location.

cases.title: Assigned to driver, no load scan
cases.symptom: Assigned to driver, no load scan
cases.source_evidence: Driver assignment, load confirmation, vehicle manifest, depot shelf scan
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Parcel may never have entered the van. Check depot stock first.

cases.title: Loaded, no delivery or return record
cases.symptom: Loaded, no delivery or return record
cases.source_evidence: Confirmed load, delivery attempts, device state, route end, depot reconciliation
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Unreconciled end-of-day custody. Contact appropriate holder or facility and request physical check.

cases.title: Driver returns, one parcel isn't scanned back
cases.symptom: Driver returns, one parcel isn't scanned back
cases.source_evidence: Return time; depot receiving scans; all route packages; target parcel identity
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Skipped return scan or still unaccounted-for parcel. Reconcile van inventory and receiving bay.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Unrecorded return, retained parcel, buffered scan or incomplete load evidence.
cases.verification_condition: Corroborated stock/custody check plus original gaps addressed; session-end policy floor remains human.

cases.title: Handover between drivers unrecorded
cases.source_evidence: Custody acknowledgements, later scans by another driver, shared-route records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Unrecorded transfer. Seek acknowledgements and establish physical custody.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Missing observation versus unconfirmed handover versus contradictory possession.
cases.verification_condition: New independent source/corroborated custody at directed location; no invented historical handover.

cases.title: Two parties claim custody
cases.source_evidence: Signed transfers, scan sources, timestamps, physical checks
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Conflicting records. Freeze automatic custody conclusion pending reconciliation.

cases.title: Parcel possibly fell from vehicle
cases.source_evidence: Confirmed loading; vehicle/door incident records; route events; physical inventory; last-known transfer
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible physical loss, not proven by missing scans or GPS. Initiate safety-appropriate route/depot checks and incident process.

cases.title: Last scan at transit hub, no later records
cases.symptom: Last scan at transit hub, no later records
cases.source_evidence: Hub receipt, planned dispatch, actual departure, next-hub receiving, device status
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Hub backlog, missing outbound scan, missed connection or parcel loss. Check both sides of transfer.

cases.title: Package found after being marked missing
cases.symptom: Package found after being marked missing
cases.source_evidence: New physical scan, identity check, search history, incident record
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Located shipment. Correct status and route it; preserve original missing incident.

cases.title: Custody scan exists but no physical confirmation
cases.symptom: Custody scan exists but no physical confirmation
cases.source_evidence: Scanner source, transfer acknowledgement, subsequent contradictory records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Administrative scan could be incomplete or wrong. Seek corroboration before closing.

cases.title: Multiple parcels missing from one vehicle
cases.symptom: Multiple parcels missing from one vehicle
cases.source_evidence: Manifest, package load scans, route history, receiving records, incident reports
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Shared vehicle, device, container or handling incident. Investigate the common cause, then individual parcels.

cases.title: Parcel stolen or tampered with — suspected
cases.symptom: Parcel stolen or tampered with — suspected
cases.source_evidence: Seal integrity, physical inventory, access logs, security reports, custody history
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Security incident is possible, but never infer theft or blame from a missing scan alone. Escalate to authorized security personnel.

cases.title: Missing parcel eventually declared lost
cases.source_evidence: Exhausted directed searches; last confirmed custody; subsequent network checks; policy deadline
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Classify as operationally lost only under the carrier's documented evidence and search policy, not immediately upon scan absence.

cases.title: Vehicle deviates from planned route
cases.source_evidence: Planned route version, observed GPS, dispatch changes, road closures
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Detour, changed instructions, incident or error. Check authorized route changes and conditions.

cases.title: Vehicle stopped for an unusually long period
cases.symptom: Vehicle stopped for an unusually long period
cases.source_evidence: GPS points, ignition/telematics if available, planned break, traffic and delivery-stop events
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Scheduled stop, traffic, breakdown, queue or delay. Investigate context before flagging wrongdoing.

cases.title: Vehicle is late arriving at depot
cases.symptom: Vehicle is late arriving at depot
cases.source_evidence: Departure, movement track, expected arrival, traffic, vehicle status
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Route or linehaul delay. Update ETA and prioritize affected shipments.

cases.title: Vehicle passes destination without delivery
cases.source_evidence: Route stops, GPS, attempt record, delivery instructions, route sequence
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Stop postponed, wrong gate, no parking, route optimization or skipped attempt. Check actual stop records.

cases.title: Vehicle GPS disappears
cases.source_evidence: Last GPS, heartbeat, mobile connectivity, device power, next observation
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Telemetry outage; location becomes unknown. Do not interpret silence as vehicle disappearance.

cases.title: GPS reports impossible jump
cases.source_evidence: Coordinate sequence, reported accuracy, timestamps, provider, other telemetry
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Bad fix, clock error or GPS spoofing possibility. Validate sensor data before operational conclusions.

cases.title: Route finished, parcels remain unresolved
cases.source_evidence: End-of-route signal; proof records; return scans; driver/device connectivity
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missing uploads or custody reconciliation issue. Open affected parcel cases.

cases.title: Vehicle appears near address, no delivery evidence
cases.symptom: Vehicle appears near address, no delivery evidence
cases.source_evidence: Location accuracy; stop event; handover, OTP, photo, customer confirmation
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Presence near destination only. Keep delivery status unverified.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Vehicle near address versus independent parcel handover; GPS uncertainty remains.

cases.title: Driver visits wrong gate or entrance
cases.symptom: Driver visits wrong gate or entrance
cases.source_evidence: Attempt location, address instructions, gate identifier, customer report
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Navigation or address-instruction discrepancy. Correct entrance details and reschedule as appropriate.

cases.title: Driver takes longer route
cases.source_evidence: Planned vs actual path, road incidents, stops, traffic and dispatch orders
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Legitimate reroute or inefficient routing. Assess delay against context; don't automatically assign blame.

cases.title: Vehicle reported at two locations simultaneously
cases.symptom: Vehicle reported at two locations simultaneously
cases.source_evidence: Device IDs, timestamps, vehicle assignments, clock sync, source systems
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Duplicate vehicle identity, stale tracker or erroneous telemetry. Reconcile identifiers.

cases.title: GPS indicates vehicle at depot but customer status remains out for delivery
cases.symptom: GPS indicates vehicle at depot but customer status remains out for delivery
cases.source_evidence: Arrival GPS, route completion, parcel return scans, tracking projection
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Likely incomplete operational or status reconciliation; verify parcel-level outcomes.

cases.title: Multiple routes late in one district
cases.symptom: Multiple routes late in one district
cases.source_evidence: GPS traces, traffic event, weather, hub dispatch, service windows
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Shared geographical disruption plausible. Group for investigation and ETA updates.

cases.title: Repeated missed stops near deadline
cases.source_evidence: Planned stop order, completed stops, missed attempts, estimated travel time
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Route overload or scheduling problem. Consider controlled reprioritization or redelivery.

cases.title: Driver phone offline
cases.source_evidence: Heartbeat history, login state, last synchronization, pending uploads
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible communications outage. Request sync when reachable; check other shipments using same device.

cases.title: Records created offline, uploaded later
cases.source_evidence: `occurred_at` versus `recorded_at`, device ID, upload batch
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Delayed synchronization is established once the buffered original events arrive and are validated.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Buffered original observation versus genuinely absent event or wrong device.
cases.verification_condition: Exact missing package observations received from target device, original occurrence time, validated provenance.

cases.title: Device online but uploads failing
cases.source_evidence: Heartbeats, upload queue, error codes, acknowledgements
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: App, API or data-pipeline failure. Retry through controlled, idempotent synchronization.

cases.title: Device battery failure
cases.source_evidence: Last battery telemetry, device shutdown, replacement-device records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Power failure plausible. Recover records or use alternative authorized scan method.

cases.title: Scanner disconnected from backend
cases.source_evidence: Local scanner reads, gateway connectivity, backend receipts
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Network or middleware fault. Preserve scans locally and reconcile after restoration.

cases.title: Device clock incorrect
cases.source_evidence: Clock synchronization, event sequence, server ingestion time
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Timestamp skew. Correct chronology with provenance; never silently rewrite original times.

cases.title: Events arrive out of order
cases.source_evidence: Event IDs, physical occurrence times, sequence numbers, receipt times
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Delayed or reordered delivery of messages. Reconstruct event order before diagnosis.

cases.title: Integration drops events
cases.source_evidence: Source acknowledgement, message-broker logs, retries, dead-letter queue
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missing ingestion pipeline record. Replay safely and check completeness.

cases.title: Tracking API returns stale status
cases.source_evidence: Backend source events, projection update time, cache age
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Read-model or cache lag. Repair projection; don't order a physical search unnecessarily.

cases.title: Device records associated with wrong driver
cases.symptom: Device records associated with wrong driver
cases.source_evidence: Session login, device assignments, shift records, scan origin
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Identity/assignment error or reused device. Audit session attribution.

cases.title: Same device affects many shipments
cases.source_evidence: Shared device ID, missing events across shipments, temporal overlap
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Shared technical incident more likely than unrelated parcel failures, but check corroborating telemetry.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Common device outage versus multiple unrelated parcel exceptions.
cases.verification_condition: Verify each affected shipment separately; incident-wide deduplication is deferred.

cases.title: System outage across many facilities
cases.source_evidence: Error logs, ingestion backlog, source-system health, regional network events
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Infrastructure incident. Pause misleading downstream conclusions and replay records after recovery.

cases.title: Parcel delivered, tracking still says in transit
cases.symptom: Parcel delivered, tracking still says in transit
cases.source_evidence: Delivery event, valid OTP, handover, status projection, upload history
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Late synchronization or tracking-status failure. Validate proof, then correct status if no unresolved conflict remains.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Valid delayed proof versus stale status or genuinely incomplete delivery.
cases.verification_condition: Authoritative bound proof and read-model agreement; no vehicle-GPS substitution.

cases.title: System says delivered, no proof exists
cases.symptom: System says delivered, no proof exists
cases.source_evidence: Status-change origin, handover record, OTP, signature, photo, recipient report
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Premature or unsupported delivered status. Request proof and consider human review.

cases.title: Delivery photograph exists, no OTP
cases.source_evidence: Photo metadata, shipment association, session, delivery policy, recipient instructions
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Photo alone may be insufficient. Seek required proof or human confirmation.

cases.title: OTP valid, photograph missing
cases.source_evidence: OTP validation, handover event, policy requirements, photo upload state
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: May support valid handover when a photo isn't mandatory. Check applicable delivery requirements.

cases.title: Wrong OTP or failed verification
cases.source_evidence: OTP validation result, linked delivery session, attempt history
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Delivery not established by failed OTP. Request legitimate retry or review. Never expose the OTP secret to the AI.

cases.title: Parcel handed to another person
cases.source_evidence: Recipient authorization, handover identity, delivery instructions, OTP/signature
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Authorized alternate recipient or disputed handover. Verify permission and escalate if uncertain.

cases.title: Delivery recorded at wrong address
cases.source_evidence: Address version, delivery metadata, photo, handover, recipient report
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible misdelivery or incorrect coordinates. Initiate authorized recovery or dispute workflow.

cases.title: Wrong compound gate
cases.source_evidence: Address instructions, attempt gate, call attempts, vehicle stop, access restrictions
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Navigation/access problem rather than missing parcel. Confirm correct entrance and arrange reattempt.

cases.title: Driver marks recipient unavailable
cases.source_evidence: Contact attempts, visit evidence, recipient communication, location and time
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Genuine failed attempt or inaccurate attempt coding. Check supporting events.

cases.title: Failed delivery reported but recipient says no attempt occurred
cases.symptom: Failed delivery reported but recipient says no attempt occurred
cases.source_evidence: Calls, attempted delivery event, vehicle stop, device status, access records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Disputed attempt. Request additional objective evidence rather than automatically accepting either account.

cases.title: Delivery proof belongs to another shipment
cases.symptom: Delivery proof belongs to another shipment
cases.source_evidence: Proof's package/session identifier, timestamps, signatures, photo metadata
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Evidence association error. Correct link; investigate original parcel separately.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Proof association error versus disputed delivery.
cases.verification_condition: Correct package/attempt/recipient-bound proof; foreign proof cannot resolve.

cases.title: Delivery status reversed
cases.source_evidence: Event history, status corrections, supersession records, reason for reversal
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: New conflicting evidence or status-processing defect. Reevaluate the full chronology.

cases.title: Driver delivers, then returns to depot before syncing
cases.symptom: Driver delivers, then returns to depot before syncing
cases.source_evidence: Offline device, return scan, later upload, handover evidence
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible normal delayed upload. Wait for original evidence or request sync.

cases.title: Parcel left at doorstep without authorized handover
cases.symptom: Parcel left at doorstep without authorized handover
cases.source_evidence: Photo, drop-off policy, customer instructions, delivery conditions
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Unattended delivery may or may not be permitted. Confirm policy and investigate dispute if reported.

cases.title: Delivery confirmed, recipient later reports non-receipt
cases.symptom: Delivery confirmed, recipient later reports non-receipt
cases.source_evidence: Valid handover evidence, recipient statement, photo, identity and address
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Delivery dispute. Preserve both sides; do not automatically accuse the recipient or driver.

cases.title: Multi-package shipment only partly delivered
cases.source_evidence: Package-level IDs, individual handovers, proof for each package
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Partial delivery. Verify each package separately before closing the overall shipment.

cases.title: Customer says not delivered; valid proof exists
cases.symptom: Customer says not delivered; valid proof exists
cases.source_evidence: OTP, recipient identity, photo, address, handover, timing
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Evidence may support delivery. Review any contradictions and follow dispute policy.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Carrier proof and recipient nonreceipt are attributed competing evidence.
cases.verification_condition: Authorized human finding with policy-required evidence; no automatic dismissal.

cases.title: Customer says delivered; system says missing
cases.symptom: Customer says delivered; system says missing
cases.source_evidence: Recipient statement, device uploads, delivery session, status events
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missing tracking event or unrecorded handover. Seek corroboration and correct status.

cases.title: Driver says delivered; no proof exists
cases.symptom: Driver says delivered; no proof exists
cases.source_evidence: Driver account, device data, parcel handover, recipient response
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Unverified delivery assertion. Request supporting evidence.

cases.title: Driver says parcel was returned; depot has no scan
cases.symptom: Driver says parcel was returned; depot has no scan
cases.source_evidence: Driver statement, return time, receiving events, stock check
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Skipped return scan or parcel still unaccounted for. Perform custody reconciliation.

cases.title: Customer says delivery attempted while nobody visited
cases.symptom: Customer says delivery attempted while nobody visited
cases.source_evidence: Attempt scan, time/location observations, communications, device records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Disputed delivery attempt. Request supporting evidence; escalate if unresolved.

cases.title: Customer reports wrong item
cases.source_evidence: Order contents, packing scan, item serials, package weight, photos
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Picking/packing error or shipment identity mix-up. Follow claims/returns policy.

cases.title: Recipient denies OTP handover
cases.source_evidence: OTP validation session, challenge logs, permitted identity proof, reported receipt
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Conflicting evidence; investigate authentication and handover integrity.

cases.title: Customer reports damaged package despite delivered status
cases.symptom: Customer reports damaged package despite delivered status
cases.source_evidence: Delivery photo, condition at handover, damage report, handling history
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Delivery status and package condition are different questions. Start damage investigation.

cases.title: Incorrect lost-shipment claim
cases.source_evidence: Subsequent physical scan, delivery proof, custody history, claim timeline
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Claim may be outdated or inconsistent with records. Correct operational finding without assigning intent.

cases.title: Multiple contradictory reports
cases.source_evidence: Report versions, creation timestamps, source identities, linked evidence
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Information may have changed or multiple parties disagree. Preserve versions and request clarification.

cases.title: Missed linehaul departure
cases.source_evidence: Planned departure, actual truck dispatch, freight handover, hub records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missed connection. Arrange next available approved transport and update ETA.

cases.title: Truck departs late
cases.source_evidence: Dispatch timestamps, loading completion, facility throughput
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Loading backlog, fleet delay or scheduling problem. Investigate upstream bottleneck.

cases.title: Truck arrives late
cases.source_evidence: GPS, traffic, departure time, arrival receipt
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Transport delay; establish the supported mechanism before reallocating blame.

cases.title: Shipment sent toward wrong destination
cases.source_evidence: Sorting outcome, linehaul manifest, destination plan, physical scan
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Missort or routing error. Intercept and redirect based on confirmed location.

cases.title: Parcel misses sorting cutoff
cases.source_evidence: Actual receiving time, operational cutoff, processing completion
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Late inbound transfer or processing backlog. Replan onward journey.

cases.title: Warehouse capacity exceeded
cases.source_evidence: Queue size, throughput and staffing, overdue cohorts
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Facility capacity constraint. Rebalance work or prioritize critical commitments.

cases.title: Traffic closure
cases.source_evidence: External traffic observation, affected route, time overlap
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Traffic disruption plausible. Recalculate route and ETA.

cases.title: Extreme weather
cases.source_evidence: Weather warnings, relevant route conditions, operational safety rules
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Weather disruption. Hold or reroute as safety policy requires.

cases.title: Vehicle breakdown
cases.source_evidence: Breakdown report, vehicle telemetry, replacement vehicle record
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Vehicle unavailable. Dispatch replacement transport and reconcile physical custody.

cases.title: Fuel or charging delay
cases.source_evidence: Fleet status, charging or refueling logs, route schedule
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Operational resource delay. Update plan and investigate repeated planning issues.

cases.title: Delivery route overloaded
cases.source_evidence: Stops allocated, completed work, travel time, service windows
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Planning/capacity issue. Reassign stops or prioritize valid commitments.

cases.title: Delivery commitment at risk
cases.source_evidence: Promise time, current milestone, estimated remaining journey, capacity
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: SLA risk, not necessarily an established failure. Trigger preventative planning.

cases.title: Holiday or business closure
cases.source_evidence: Delivery calendar, recipient/facility hours, service promise rules
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Scheduled closure or unavailable destination. Reschedule and avoid false overdue alert.

cases.title: No available delivery appointment
cases.source_evidence: Appointment slots, access windows, recipient preferences
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Scheduling constraint. Offer available appointment or approved alternative.

cases.title: Weight differs from declaration
cases.source_evidence: Original declaration, calibrated measurements, tolerance and scale IDs
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Incorrect declaration, measurement error or content discrepancy. Request independent reweigh.
cases.source_data_supported: partial: relevant record kinds exist; complete case proof not asserted
cases.investigatable: existing bounded tools plus evidence-first guide
cases.competing_hypotheses: Scale error versus declaration error or real integrity discrepancy.
cases.verification_condition: Independent calibrated package-bound measurement within policy tolerances.

cases.title: One scale reads many parcels incorrectly
cases.symptom: One scale reads many parcels incorrectly
cases.source_evidence: Measurements across shipments, calibration history, comparison scale
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Scale drift. Quarantine affected measurements and recalibrate.

cases.title: Parcel weight drops unexpectedly
cases.source_evidence: Reliable previous and current weights, packaging changes, handling events
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible contents loss, repackaging or measurement error. Inspect physically.

cases.title: Parcel damaged in transit
cases.source_evidence: Damage photos, handling and custody timeline, condition records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Physical handling or transport damage. Isolate, document and follow claim policy.

cases.title: Seal broken
cases.source_evidence: Seal identifier, original sealing event, inspection photos, transfer records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Packaging integrity compromised. Security/quality review as appropriate.

cases.title: Parcel empty at delivery
cases.source_evidence: Packing verification, weight chronology, seal checks, delivery report
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Potential content discrepancy. Preserve physical evidence and investigate custody.

cases.title: Temperature excursion
cases.source_evidence: Calibrated temperature sensor logs, transport time, permitted threshold
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible cold-chain breach. Quarantine according to product policy.

cases.title: Shock/tilt excursion
cases.source_evidence: Sensor readings, calibration, handling time, product fragility
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Possible physical damage. Inspect before deciding usability.

cases.title: Leakage or hazardous condition
cases.source_evidence: Incident report, material classification, handling procedures
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Safety-sensitive. Follow emergency and hazardous-goods procedure immediately.

cases.title: Suspected counterfeit/replaced parcel
cases.source_evidence: Serialized IDs, packaging, source history, tamper records
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Identity or integrity concern. Escalate to authorized inspection/security.

cases.title: Return requested but parcel remains with recipient
cases.symptom: Return requested but parcel remains with recipient
cases.source_evidence: Return authorization, pickup event, custody receipt
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Pickup never completed or record missing. Confirm appointment and actual handover.

cases.title: Driver collects return but no depot receipt
cases.symptom: Driver collects return but no depot receipt
cases.source_evidence: Collection scan, vehicle manifest, depot receiving
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Return custody gap. Reconcile vehicle and depot.

cases.title: Return sent to wrong facility
cases.source_evidence: Return-routing instruction, container, receiving scan
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Reverse-logistics missort. Redirect based on physical scan.

cases.title: Return lost in transit
cases.source_evidence: Last confirmed custody, linehaul transfer, inventory checks
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Unaccounted-for return. Initiate directed trace and loss procedure.

cases.title: Return received but refund not triggered
cases.symptom: Return received but refund not triggered
cases.source_evidence: Receiving inspection, return authorization, finance-system event
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Workflow/integration discrepancy. Refer to authorized finance policy.

cases.title: Returned item does not match original order
cases.symptom: Returned item does not match original order
cases.source_evidence: Serialized product identifier, packing/return inspection, condition
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Item mismatch. Human quality/claims review.

cases.title: Parcel returned without required reason
cases.source_evidence: Failed attempts, recipient instruction, return rule
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Unsupported return decision. Verify applicable rule and missing evidence.

cases.title: Return scan appears before original delivery attempt
cases.symptom: Return scan appears before original delivery attempt
cases.source_evidence: Event and record times, transaction relationships, corrections
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Chronology, identity or wrong-workflow error. Reconcile before closing.

cases.title: Customs documentation missing
cases.source_evidence: Invoice, declaration, commodity details, broker response
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Documentation hold. Request the required files.

cases.title: HS classification dispute
cases.source_evidence: Commodity description, tariff code, customs feedback
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Classification conflict. Human customs-specialist review.

cases.title: Duty or tax clearance pending
cases.source_evidence: Customs release, payment/guarantee status, broker messages
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Financial or customs hold. Route to authorized party.

cases.title: Restricted or prohibited goods suspected
cases.source_evidence: Declared goods, screening result, regulations
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Compliance concern. Hold and escalate; do not automatically clear.

cases.title: Border security inspection
cases.source_evidence: Government or carrier inspection notices, release status
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: External operational hold. Monitor authoritative release.

cases.title: International transfer missing
cases.source_evidence: Origin dispatch, flight/truck/container manifest, destination receipt
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Cross-carrier custody or interface discrepancy. Trace both providers.

cases.title: Different carriers report conflicting statuses
cases.source_evidence: Each provider's raw events, IDs, time zones, transfer acknowledgement
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Status-mapping error or missed transfer. Reconcile authoritative events.

cases.title: Flight/port disruption
cases.source_evidence: Carrier schedule revision, transport booking, arrival scan
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Transportation disruption. Rebook as permitted and update ETA.

cases.title: One offline phone affects 30 parcels
cases.source_evidence: Shared device, missing uploads, same period
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: One device investigation and a coordinated synchronization request

cases.title: One scanner misreads hundreds of labels
cases.symptom: One scanner misreads hundreds of labels
cases.source_evidence: Scanner ID, unusual read-error rate
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Remove faulty scanner, recheck affected events

cases.title: Sorting chute creates repeated missorts
cases.source_evidence: Diverter/chute, destination mismatches, timestamps
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Inspect sorter and identify all affected containers

cases.title: One hub processing backlog affects several routes
cases.symptom: One hub processing backlog affects several routes
cases.source_evidence: Facility throughput, queues, missed cutoffs
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Open facility incident and coordinate capacity response

cases.title: Several parcels omitted from one manifest revision
cases.symptom: Several parcels omitted from one manifest revision
cases.source_evidence: Manifest version, package scans, loading confirmations
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: One dispatch-data reconciliation plus parcel-level verification

cases.title: One vehicle breakdown delays multiple shipments
cases.symptom: One vehicle breakdown delays multiple shipments
cases.source_evidence: Vehicle event, route assignment, affected shipment IDs
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Shared replacement-vehicle planning

cases.title: Large regional connectivity outage
cases.source_evidence: Device heartbeats, upload failures and network alerts
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Infrastructure incident; defer unsupported parcel-loss conclusions

cases.title: Shared incorrect address master data
cases.source_evidence: Address version, repeated failed attempts, customer reports
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Correct source record and identify impacted deliveries

cases.title: Duplicate operational requests
cases.source_evidence: Same target device, similar open cases, existing requests
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Deduplicate authorized actions without combining distinct closure criteria

cases.title: Many false overdue statuses after system recovery
cases.symptom: Many false overdue statuses after system recovery
cases.source_evidence: Delayed ingestion batches, source event times, status projections
cases.catalogued_response_guidance: Replay and correct data before creating unnecessary field investigations
